messages.content: It is completely understandable that doubt sets in when the struggle feels endless, yet there are countless people who find those exact same "loud" moments quiet and manageable over time. Many individuals with these profound feelings, often associated with social anxiety or autism, discovered that eventually, their unique way of being no longer felt like a betrayal of the world but rather a fresh perspective. Healing is rarely linear, but taking even one tiny step toward a supportive community can reshape that hopeless outlook forward.
